simple.meaning: הֲדָרָה (hădârâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “decoration.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, Psalms, Proverbs, beginning at 1 Chronicles 16:29. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הֲדָרָה (H1927).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H1927. hadarah [ הֲדָרָה ] noun feminine adornment, glory — only construct הַדְרַת ; — 1 קֹֿדֶשׁ׳ה holy adornment (Che Psalm ), always in connection with public worship of ׳י 1Chr 16:29 ; 2Chr 20:21 ; Psa 29:2 ; 96:9 . 2 מֶֿלֶךְ׳ה the glory of a king , figurative of רָבעַֿם , Prov 14:28 .

occurrences.englishText: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name.

When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to Yahweh, and give praise in holy array, as they go out before the army, and say, “Give thanks to Yahweh; for his loving kindness endures forever.”
Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name.
In the multitude of people is the king’s glory,
